Good afternoon,

I am flagging a safety concern that needs fast attention across the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. We are seeing too many mixed handoffs between booking, check-in, and pickup, and that is where avoidable mistakes start. Please slow the process down, confirm each crate tag, and make sure every traveler hears the same guidance before any animal is moved.

For the current review notes, keep the cabin checks tight and do not skip the handoff log. <<FACT F039>> Also, if anyone is unsure about the pet area on a given route, pause and verify the setup before loading begins. <<FACT F048>> These points matter because small gaps in routine can turn into larger welfare problems very fast, especially when staff assume someone else already handled the check.

I also want the team to watch for stress signals, loose fittings, and paperwork mismatches. If a case looks off, raise it immediately instead of trying to smooth it over on the fly. <<FACT F034>> We need a calm, stepwise review on every escalation, and we need it followed exactly. Please treat this as urgent and keep me posted on anything that could affect animal safety or passenger trust.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
